mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a current temperature of 70 degrees. We are looking at an overnight low of 66 degrees with no rain predicted.

Important updates for the city include a major construction project on Highway M starting August 18, which will involve lane shifts and utility work for a few weeks. Also, the city's new student-designed I Voted stickers will be featured in the November election following the recent community contest.

There is plenty to do in our community starting tomorrow, including Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and trivia night at Hop Haus. Looking ahead, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's this weekend, or check out the Cave Carnival on August 16.

In a noteworthy call from the past week, on August 8, a drone pilot from the Verona Police Department assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office in locating a suspect vehicle that fled into a cornfield after a burglary in the Town of Christiana.
The delicious flavor of the day today is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The shop is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM tomorrow morning.
